name: PER_MEDICAL_ASSESSMENTS
description: This table stores the medical assessments for the person.

columns.name: MEDICAL_ASSESSMENT_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key. Surrogate key.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person for whom the medical assessment is recorded

columns.name: EXAMINER_NAME
columns.description: Name of examiner who performed consultation

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Organization in which this assessment came about. Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: CONSULTATION_DATE
columns.description: Date of medical consultation

columns.name: CONSULTATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of medical assessment

columns.name: CONSULTATION_RESULT
columns.description: Result of medical assessment

columns.name: DISABILITY_ID
columns.description: Disability referenced by this assessment. Foreign key to PER_WORK_INCIDENTS

columns.name: INCIDENT_ID
columns.description: Incident referenced by this assessment. Foreign key to PER_WORK_INCIDENTS

columns.name: NEXT_CONSULTATION_DATE
columns.description: Date of next medical assessments

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of medical assessment

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
